name: kr.akif/blog
title: akif.kr
description: Read-only access to Akif Karakus's blog: list, search and read posts and guides as markdown. No authentication.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List every blog post and guide with slug, title, summary, date, tags and URLs.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Find posts and guides by words in their title, summary, tags or keywords.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get the full content of a post or guide as markdown, by slug.
